paths.description: Marketplace home and primary search/category entry point; representative global shell and consent experience.
Electronics category listing; representative browse/results template.
Direct search results for “rower”; representative primary search journey.
Representative product/detail listing reached from the home recommendations.

findings.summary: The interface ignores the user’s dark colour-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The valid dark-mode screenshot remains a light surface, and the CSS probe found zero prefers-color-scheme rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Add color-scheme: light dark and theme surfaces with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: The consent layer obscures the primary marketplace content on first load.
findings.evidence: Mobile and desktop screenshots show a large consent layer over search, categories, and listings before any interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the blocking wall with a compact, content-preserving consent surface while retaining equally easy essential-only choice.

findings.summary: The consent overlay is custom rather than a semantic dialog.
findings.evidence: The live probe found 0 dialog, 0 popover, and 0 details elements while the screenshot shows a modal-like consent layer.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a native dialog for modal consent, with correct focus management and platform dismissal semantics.

findings.summary: Persistent app, safety, and consent chrome crowds the content.
findings.evidence: The first desktop viewport contains an app banner, fraud warning, search chrome, and a wide consent panel; mobile content is largely covered.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate non-content banners, reserve persistent chrome for essential actions, and let listings dominate the first viewport.

findings.summary: Many interactive targets are too small for reliable touch.
findings.evidence: The live 390x844 probe found repeated favourite buttons at 22x22 CSS px and multiple links only 18–20px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Expand hit areas to at least 24x24 CSS px, preferably 44x44 for primary touch controls, without enlarging icons visually.

findings.summary: Layout stability misses the good Core Web Vitals range.
findings.evidence: Raw CDP observation measured LCP 1.28s but CLS 0.160, above the 0.10 good threshold, with two long tasks of 123ms and 222ms.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve late content space and break up long tasks; verify field INP and CLS after deployment.

findings.summary: Images commonly lack intrinsic dimensions, increasing shift risk.
findings.evidence: The image probe found 46 of 48 images without width/height; the live layout-shift observer measured CLS 0.160.
findings.suggestedFix: Set width and height or aspect-ratio on every image/card media slot before content arrives.

findings.summary: Long main-thread tasks delay responsiveness after load.
findings.evidence: The CDP performance observer recorded 123ms and 222ms long tasks; Performance.getMetrics reported 1.02s task time and 0.28s script time in the observed window.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the long-task scripts, split work into sub-50ms tasks, and schedule non-critical work by priority.

findings.summary: The home page performs a broad, eager resource load.
findings.evidence: The valid CDP run recorded 215 Resource Timing entries; the image probe found all 48 images without loading=lazy and 25 legacy-format images.
findings.suggestedFix: Lazy-load below-fold media, reduce early connection/resource fan-out, and deliver modern responsive image variants.

findings.summary: The initial runtime and dependency surface is unusually large.
findings.evidence: The page loaded 215 resources, retained about 72MB JS heap, and logged several unsatisfied shared-singleton version warnings.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit bundle federation/version duplication, remove unused chunks, and conditionally load secondary analytics, ads, and account features.

findings.summary: Some images have no accessible alternative.
findings.evidence: axe reported a critical image-alt violation; the image probe counted 30 images without alt attributes.
findings.suggestedFix: Give meaningful images concise alt text and mark decorative images alt="" or role="presentation".

findings.summary: Footer link text fails WCAG AA contrast.
findings.evidence: axe measured 2.8:1 contrast for 12px #7f9799 text on #f2f4f5 across OLX network links, below 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a darker text token that reaches at least 4.5:1 for normal text.

findings.summary: The page lacks a coherent landmark and heading hierarchy.
findings.evidence: The probe found no main or nav landmark and no H1; axe reported invalid H4 heading order and content outside landmarks.
findings.suggestedFix: Add one descriptive H1, wrap primary content in main, use nav landmarks, and keep heading levels sequential.

findings.summary: Small controls weaken zoomed and touch use.
findings.evidence: At the mobile condition, favourite controls measured 22x22 CSS px and many category links were only 20px high, despite a valid scalable viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase interactive hit areas and retest at 200% zoom and narrow reflow.

findings.summary: The page emits a CSP media error and numerous platform warnings.
findings.evidence: The CDP console probe captured one CSP-blocked data: video error plus 13 Permissions-Policy and shared-module-version warnings.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the blocked probe/media load, update obsolete Permissions-Policy directives, and align shared module versions.

findings.summary: Image asset markup is incomplete and inefficient.
findings.evidence: Although charset and viewport are valid, 46 of 48 images omit dimensions and 25 use legacy formats.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic image dimensions and responsive modern sources from the rendering layer.

findings.summary: Permissions-Policy contains directives this Chrome build rejects.
findings.evidence: CDP logged unrecognized ambient-light-sensor, battery, document-domain, execution-while-not-rendered, execution-while-out-of-viewport, navigation-override, and web-share features.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate Permissions-Policy from currently supported directives and remove stale entries.

findings.summary: The CSP is permissive and two first-party cookies lack Secure.
findings.evidence: headers found script-src allowing unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval; cookies found deviceGUID and OptanonConsent without Secure, with deviceGUID SameSite=None and 400-day expiry.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt nonce/hash-based CSP without unsafe-eval and mark all HTTPS cookies Secure with the narrowest SameSite policy.

findings.summary: The first-load third-party and tracking footprint is extensive.
findings.evidence: The tracker capture found 28 third-party origins and five known tracker domains, including DoubleClick, New Relic, and Sentry.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate non-essential vendors behind consent, remove low-value trackers, and batch/minimise analytics payloads.

findings.summary: Browser defenses exist but are weakened by broad policy.
findings.evidence: HSTS, nosniff, SAMEORIGIN and Referrer-Policy are present, but CSP allows * plus unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval and Permissions-Policy allows camera/geolocation/payment broadly.
findings.suggestedFix: Narrow CSP sources and Permissions-Policy capabilities to the origins and features actually required.

findings.summary: The app-like marketplace is controlled by a service worker but exposes no manifest link.
findings.evidence: The live probe found an active service-worker controller and mobile-app meta, but no link rel=manifest.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish a complete web app manifest and verify an intentional offline fallback for browse/detail routes.

findings.summary: The Polish document does not declare its language.
findings.evidence: Both the DOM primitive and axe show an empty html lang attribute; axe rates html-has-lang serious.
findings.suggestedFix: Set <html lang="pl"> server-side and set dir explicitly when supporting bidirectional locales.

findings.summary: Below-fold image delivery is not resource-efficient.
findings.evidence: The image probe found 25 legacy-format images, 48 below-fold images not lazy-loaded, 46 without dimensions, and one oversized asset.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve AVIF/WebP responsive variants and lazy-load below-fold images with fixed intrinsic geometry.

findings.summary: Third-party scripts are disproportionate to the first-load task.
findings.evidence: The tracker probe observed 28 third-party origins; the runtime loaded 215 resources before a user started a search.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party request/byte budget and defer ads, surveys, analytics, and monitoring until needed and consented.

findings.summary: The home page has a heavy baseline memory footprint.
findings.evidence: Heap summary measured 64.1MB self size across 1.18M heap nodes; CDP reported 72.0MB used JS heap and 3,888 event listeners.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce eagerly mounted modules/listeners and lazy-initialize secondary widgets; track heap and listener budgets in CI.
